# Deep Navy

> Deep Navy is an early-access SaaS platform for hiring a coordinated autonomous AI engineering team. It connects business objectives to reviewed delivery, explicit approvals, engineering cost, and observed product outcomes.

## Primary pages

- [Product]({{ '/product/' | absolute_url }}): Operating loop, team roles, and customer visibility
- [Solutions]({{ '/solutions/' | absolute_url }}): Founders, product leaders, and engineering leaders
- [Engineering Economics]({{ '/economics/' | absolute_url }}): Cost attribution and Engineering Credits
- [Pricing]({{ '/pricing/' | absolute_url }}): Founding-team pilot model
- [Documentation]({{ '/docs/' | absolute_url }}): Authentication and onboarding guide
- [Architecture]({{ '/architecture/' | absolute_url }}): System ownership and isolation model
- [GitHub integration]({{ '/integrations/github/' | absolute_url }}): Installation and repository access
- [Security]({{ '/security/' | absolute_url }}): Security design and vulnerability reporting
- [Trust center]({{ '/trust/' | absolute_url }}): Current and planned control status

## Important qualifications

- Deep Navy is in early access.
- Customer claims, certifications, and performance metrics are not implied unless explicitly published with evidence.
- Engineering outcome attribution is not automatically a causal claim.
- The browser never receives GitHub App, AWS, Stripe, OpenClaw, LiteLLM, or Langfuse secrets.
